associations.rationale: It states that every simple finite-dimensional representation of Z/n is isomorphic to a character representation, directly giving the classification of irreducibles as characters.
It characterizes complex type exactly as a character that is neither trivial nor an available sign character, directly stating the every-other-character complex-type classification.
It characterizes real type exactly as the trivial character or a sign character, directly matching the stated real-type classification.
